text: Pressing E while aiming at 'Your wagon' (the cart body) does nothing and shows no message; the crosshair names only 'Your wagon' with hint 'Tools, planks, shingles and furnishings', so it's unclear you must aim at a specific pile.
Finding the new planks on the wagon took several tries: the plank stack is a small dark box at the back, crosshair over most of the cart only says 'Your wagon'. Shingles were found by accident first.

Rotten floorboards render as dark/green squares that look like an open hole; aiming at the middle names nothing (aim None) and holding the button with planks does nothing. Only at an edge does it say 'Rotten floorboard - Put the plank down and pry this up first (5)'. Nothing told me before the wagon trip that the rotten boards must be pried up first.

Carrying the plank stack indoors, the rotten floorboard says 'Put the plank down and pry this up first', but E anywhere in the cabin only answers 'Hold the plank over a gap in the floor and work it in'. The stack can't be set down indoors; you must walk back to the wagon to return it, then come back with the pry bar.

With 3 new planks in hand and the crosshair squarely over the open gap left by a pried-up rotten board, the centre names nothing (aim None) and holding the left button for 4 s does nothing; planksLeft stays 3.
